dslRule:
<!id: junit-assert-true-int-equality-to-assert-equals>
<!description: Replace junit.framework.TestCase.assertTrue($x == $y) with assertEquals($y, $x) for integer equality checks.>
<!severity: HINT>
junit.framework.TestCase.assertTrue($left == $right); :: instanceof($left, "java.lang.Integer") && instanceof($right, "java.lang.Integer")
=> junit.framework.TestCase.assertEquals($right, $left);
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
